slides.title: Drag and drop that just works
slides.body: The panel, dock, command bar and tiles now take dropped files smoothly, without jumping around.
bullets: A tool lights up when you drag over it
Drop files anywhere on the bar, then search for the tool you want
Right-click a tool, or tap the star, to pin it to the front
slides.tip: Hold Alt and drag a file out of Explorer to open your favourite style.

slides.title: A finish you can use
slides.body: When a job is done you now see how much smaller it got, with buttons to open the result or find it in its folder.
bullets: For example: 2.4 MB to 186 KB, 92% smaller
A full disk is explained in plain words
